surprise.title: Today is the third and last Friday the 13th of 2026, and the most a year can have
surprise.body: A month only gets a Friday the 13th when it starts on a Sunday, and this November did. That gives 2026 three of them (February, March, and today), which is the maximum any year can hold; the next one isn't until August 13, 2027. Here's the twist: across the Gregorian calendar's 400-year cycle, the 13th lands on a Friday very slightly more often than on any other weekday. The superstition itself is younger than people think, with no record of Friday and 13 being called unlucky together before the 19th century. One of the earliest English mentions is musical: the opera composer Gioachino Rossini, of William Tell Overture fame, who reportedly distrusted both Fridays and the number 13, died on Friday, November 13, 1868, exactly 158 years ago today. If you want to answer that with some live music, Blue Tavern has Songwriters in the Round tonight at 8 PM, $10. It will be clear and dry but chilly, around 57°F at 6 PM and near 50°F by 9, so bring a jacket.
